changes.title: Global launch
changes.forever: Launches November 4, 2026 at 3:00 PM PST. Beta began September 17, 2026.

changes.title: Original Azeroth setting
changes.forever: Set in an expanded original Azeroth, after Forsaken Kingdom and before Molten Core. Not a Classic season and not a version that advances through expansions.

changes.title: Level 1–60 journey with 1,000+ quests
changes.forever: The 1–60 journey has more than 1,000 quests across the original continents.
changes.vanilla: Vanilla levelling covers 1–60 on the original continents.

changes.title: New and reimagined regions
changes.forever: Four new or reimagined regions: Mount Hyjal, Shen’dralas, Riverglades and Zephras Isle.

changes.title: Nine new dungeons
changes.forever: Nine new dungeons are added. Loot and boss details are tracked on ForeverChanges.

changes.title: Skyborne race
changes.forever: A new playable race, the Skyborne, is added.

changes.title: No flying mounts
changes.forever: Flying mounts are not part of Forever’s design principles. Travel relies on the world itself.
changes.vanilla: Vanilla had no flying mounts; flying arrived in The Burning Crusade.

changes.title: No level scaling
changes.forever: Content does not scale to your level. Preparation and cooperation matter more than gear level.

changes.title: Legacy progression
changes.forever: A Legacy progression system carries progress forward across Forever.

changes.title: Realmless play by ruleset
changes.forever: Players are organised by ruleset rather than by realm.
changes.vanilla: Vanilla characters live on individual realms.

changes.title: Opt-in transmogrification
changes.forever: Transmog is opt-in, so appearance changes are a choice.
changes.vanilla: Transmog did not exist in vanilla; it was added in Legion.

changes.title: Reworked profession systems
changes.forever: Profession systems, including camping, are reworked. See the Deep Dive recap for details.

changes.title: Combat and itemization changes
changes.forever: Combat and itemization are changed from vanilla. Item-level detail is tracked on ForeverChanges.

changes.title: New battleground
changes.forever: A new battleground is part of the launch content.

changes.title: Thousands of item changes
changes.forever: The beta build showed 5,619 new items and 4,584 changed items.

changes.title: Spell and talent changes
changes.forever: The beta build showed 759 talent and spell changes compared with Classic.
